prompt:
Theme:
gaze through sunglasses

Subject:
Depict a mature woman relaxing in a bright indoor setting. A vertical fashion portrait showing the person from the top of the head to below the waist, positioned slightly to the right of center. A mature, well-proportioned figure with a slim waist and natural feminine curves.

Character and Expression:
Dark brown short bob. Hair ends move naturally in and out below the chin, with thin see-through bangs over the forehead. Elegant Japanese-style makeup with brown eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, delicate lashes, pale coral pink blush, and matte pink-beige lips. Tilting the head slightly left, staring straight at the camera from under brown lenses. A modest, confident smile on the lips.

Clothing and Pose:
An ivory fine-ribbed knit camisole crop top. Deep V-line but the chest is naturally covered, clearly showing the stretch and seams of the soft knit. The bottom is a matching room-wear style design. The person raises her right hand to the front of her face, lightly pushing down the bridge of the sunglasses with the tip of her index finger. The other fingers are naturally bent. The left arm is extended to the lower right, resting weight as if supporting the seat. The upper body is slightly tilted to the right, and the waist is gently twisted in the opposite direction.

promptZh:
主题：
透过太阳镜凝视

主体：
描绘一位成熟女性在明亮的室内环境中放松的场景。这是一张竖构图的时尚人像，展示从头顶到腰部以下的人物，位置略微偏右。人物体态成熟匀称，腰部纤细，展现自然的女性曲线。

角色与表情：
深棕色短波波头。发梢在下巴处自然内扣，额前留有轻薄的空气刘海。优雅的日系妆容，搭配棕色眼影、细眼线、精致睫毛、淡珊瑚粉色腮红以及哑光粉米色唇妆。 头部微微向左倾斜，透过棕色镜片直视镜头。嘴角带着含蓄而自信的微笑。

服装与姿势：
象牙色细罗纹针织吊带短款上衣。深 V 领设计，但胸部自然遮盖，清晰展现出柔软针织面料的弹力与缝线细节。 下身搭配同款家居风格服饰。人物右手抬至面部前方，食指指尖轻推太阳镜鼻托。其余手指自然弯曲。左臂向右下方伸展，支撑身体重心，仿佛靠在座椅上。上半身略微向右倾斜，腰部向相反方向轻微扭转。
